blockers.exact: No Docker-compatible runtime or local Docker API socket.
blockers.policy: Official Supabase local-development requires a container manager. Privileged container/daemon setup, remote Docker context, and hosted Supabase fallback are forbidden.

container.note: No docker/podman/nerdctl binary and no local Docker/Podman socket.

browser.note: Use Playwright launchPersistentContext with a run-owned user-data-dir. A shared Chrome user-data-dir screenshot hung in this environment and is not the acceptance path.

environment.note: Parent process may contain hosted connector names. This harness never reads those values and never uses them as a fallback. Child environments are rebuilt from synthetic loopback values only.

limitations: Exact self-hosted gateway/image versions are NOT RUN until an owned `supabase start` succeeds.
Do not assume historical Compose or Kong defaults.
Hosted Production/Development and the parent connector credentials are unused.
